violet: quick flag 1: audit-bot found a leaked Vault value reference in backup-archive for payments-ingest (pattern looks like PROD_KEY_zz7). marking high.

audit-bot: (automated) leak_detected severity=high path=s3://backups/payments/2024/11/rotate.log pattern=PROD_KEY_zz7

sam: I'm taking rotation. We'll assume compromise. Steps: revoke partner key, create new key, write to Vault kv-v2, rewrap with KMS, and upload to partner portal.

ryan: also, create a temporary Vault policy to restrict reads to svc-payments and security-admins for 2 hours. Lockdown first, rotate second.

sam: doing lockdown now & rotating. Commands (redacted):
```bash
vault policy write temp-lockdown - <<'HCL'
path "secret/data/services/payments" { capabilities = ["read","update"] }
HCL
# bind to svc-payments
vault write auth/kubernetes/role/svc-payments policies=temp-lockdown ...
```

sam: new key written at 2026-03-21T20:05:12Z, Vault req=req-7c2, KMS key version=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/partners/cryptoKeyVersions/9

violet: scanning repo history and CI artifacts for matches. If found, we'll rotate dependent tokens and invalidate old images.

ryan: ops to schedule archive-rewrite to scrub plaintext tokens from backups (JOB-980). Also add pre-upload validation to reject token-like patterns.

audit-bot: post-rotation scan: matches_before=1 matches_after=0 scanned_path=s3://backups/payments/2024/

sam: partner acknowledged revocation ticket PART-2026-912 and accepted new key via portal. containment=complete. Scheduling short postmortem.
